name: emits-frontmatter
description: The note must open with the YAML frontmatter block other tools read: date, ticket, and the fixed theme/category/signals enums classified from the session. With no values in the settings, it carries no values key and no Values section.
prompt:
Summarize this work session and produce the final markdown note now — do not ask
me anything:
- For ticket ABC-42, wrote failing specs for retry exhaustion and circuit-open first,
  then added exponential backoff and a circuit breaker to PartnerSyncService.
- Also dropped the default config.yaml timeout from 30s to 10s on my own initiative.

Name the session after ticket ABC-42.

assertions.description: classifies the shipped fix under the delivery theme
records the ticket in machine-readable frontmatter
captures the process signals evidenced in the session
leaves the Values section out when the settings set no values
